<subject>Catherine Storey for Corporate Transactions Closing</subject>
<body>
I talked to each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this topic got pushed aside due to some other pressing issues. However, each of you agreed that a standard cutoff time was acceptable for M&A documentation, regulatory filings and contract execution.

The best option will be to agree to cutoff at 3pm each day (just to get an idea of the numbers we were talking about, I looked at yesterday to determine how many matters were finalised after 3pm London time. We had three acquisition agreements, and two regulatory compliance submissions). After 3pm, the workflow systems would automatically roll new Corporate matters to the next day. However, for those transactions that do not close after 3pm, the various practice groups would need to remember that these matters are the following day's business. I am not sure how the procedures in the Finance & Operations team would need to be modified for the partner's billing records, as the official books would not include these late transactions. Can Finance & Operations run supplemental reports to ensure that the teams have accurate time entries and matter status each morning?

I would appreciate any comments that you may have, and regardless, please re-confirm that a cutoff of 3pm works for each of your respective groups.

Danielle
x36557

Eric - any potential problems with the matter management system?
Mary - we discussed briefly a few weeks back...any thoughts?
</body>
